name: privatenote
description: End-to-end encrypted note sharing for Codex — bundled MCP server and skills.

interface.shortDescription: Share secrets as encrypted, self-destructing links
interface.longDescription: Create PrivateNote links with local AES-256-GCM encryption before upload. Bundles the privatenote-mcp server for Codex agents and documents when to use the VS Code extension instead (no AI sees the plaintext).
defaultPrompt: Create a burn-after-reading PrivateNote for this credential, expiring in 24 hours.
Share this secret as a PrivateNote link — do not repeat the plaintext in chat.
